_comment: The kit. Every number here is tuning, not code -- adding a tool is an entry in this list, which is what lets the kit grow without touching the game. reach: stream (held, a cone that sweeps with the cursor), adjacent (one puff beside him), thrown (travels). arc is the cone half-angle in degrees; 0 is a full circle. For a stream, stamina and charge are per SECOND held; otherwise per use. scaling carries per-stat grades the damage formula blends with the player's sheet (see config/stats.json scaling.per_point) -- the wand is a chemical-scaling tool. Body tuning (stamina max, recovery) lives in config/stats.json, derived from stats.

spray._comment: How a held stream LOOKS -- droplet emission, flight and dispersal. Presentation only: damage rides the cone. speed_base/speed_var are fractions of the cone radius per second, and the damaging front's sweep derives from their sum, so the kill always rides the tip of the visible wave. spread_inside is the fraction of the damaging arc droplets fan across (kept under 1 so nothing drawn overstates reach).
